 ▲ candle   SETUP   nothing trades until your agent and its limits exist        
 ✓ 0  ▸ 1 Sign in to Candle  · 2  · 3  · 4  · 5                                 
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── step 1 of 5 ─╮
│                                                                              │
│  Sign in to Candle                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  This machine has no keychain, so the Candle CLI keeps its sign-in in a      │
│  file locked by a passphrase you choose. The Candle Harness reads it when    │
│  it starts, so set it first:                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│    echo 'export CANDLE_KEYRING_PASSPHRASE="<a passphrase of your own>"' >>   │
│    ~/.bashrc                                                                 │
│  ▸ ⧉ Copy the line                      then put your own passphrase in it   │
│                                                                              │
│  Then quit (ctrl-c twice), open a new terminal, and run candle-harness       │
│  again. Keep the same passphrase from then on.                               │
│                                                                              │
│  This isn't a vault's passphrase. It only locks the CLI's sign-in file on    │
│  this machine; a vault, if you make one, has its own.                        │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 ↑/↓ moves · ⏎ or a click picks · esc back                      ctrl-c ×2 quits
